label: fixture
title: pnpm lockfileVersion 9: specifier workspace:* and version link:../../packages/shared-kit vs registry
notes: pnpm records workspace protocol in specifier and a link: path as the locked version. That link path is the identity. A registry tarball of the same name is a different identity.

decisionNotes: pnpm locked version is link:../../packages/shared-kit with specifier workspace:*.
link: is a workspace path identity, not a registry version.
Upgrade target registry locator of the same name ⇒ unknown (rules 3 and 5).
pnpm-lock.yaml is parsed heuristically (no YAML library). Unparseable lockfile would also be unknown.
A newer version is not itself a break.
